text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from about 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling and fewer evenings spent on CRM updates.

**2. Notes got better, not just faster.** Next steps, objections, and budget signals were captured consistently, even from our least detail-oriented reps.

**3. Trust took work.** Customers asked about recording. A simple opening line, "I'm using a note-taker so I can stay present," solved it.

**4. Managers coached differently.** Searchable call summaries replaced ride-alongs for early feedback.

**5. Adoption followed value.** Reps used it when summaries fed the CRM automatically.

Would your team pilot it?

#SalesEnablement #AI #B2BSales
